Color classification for leaflet map

genColorInfo.Rd

Color classification for leaflet map

Usage

genColorInfo(
  values = NA,
  pol = NULL,
  field = NULL,
  n = 5,
  style = "kmeans",
  valClass = NULL,
  colPal = "seaborn.bright",
  colType = "cat",
  reverse = FALSE,
  opacity = 1
)

Arguments

values

A numeric vector of values to classify

pol

a data.frame.

field

The name of the column to use for classification.

n

Number of classes

style

Style of classification. One of: "fixed", "sd", "equal", "pretty", "quantile", "kmeans", "hclust", "bclust", "fisher", "jenks", "dpih", "headtails", "maximum", or "box".

valClass

An object of the class classIntervals to set the classification manually

colPal

Full name of a color palette.

colType

Type of palette: "cat", "seq", "div" or "cyc".

reverse

Should the palette be reversed?

opacity

Legend opacity
